author: Ankit
problem: Stations 1 to N lie on a line; one train runs from 1 to N stopping at every station, another from N to 1. Read N, X, Y and Z (X, Y, Z distinct) and print Yes if a trip from station X to station Y stops at station Z, otherwise No.
bug_description: Only handles trips with X < Y; trips toward station 1 always get No.

comments.accurate: Checks whether station Z lies between X and Y on the trip
comments.wrong_behavior: Yes only when Z comes after X and before Y in station order
comments.wrong_location: Between check verified; check that all four numbers are read from one line

source.buggy_line: print("Yes" if x < z < y else "No")
source.fixed_line: print("Yes" if x < z < y or y < z < x else "No")
